parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, border, detention or police targeting of visitors is documented. Hate-crime and hate-speech laws include gender identity, providing formal recourse, though application is contested. The main traveller exposure is a current, company-wide swimming-pool changing-room restriction with legal contestation and unknown scope beyond that chain. Narrowed minor clinical access is guidance not a ban, relevant mainly to a travelling minor. Organised opposition and intimidation target advocates locally, not shown to reach visitors. Overall: reduced risk with an unremedied facility exclusion.

entry_documents.interaction: No entry or document-check rule is documented; absence is not treated as safety.

investigation_detention_custody.interaction: No custody placement, search or detention rule for visitors is documented.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: National swimming-pool chain from Oct 2025 bars trans customers from choosing changing rooms; scope beyond chain not documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: No general birth-sex facility ban is documented; changing-room access otherwise described as not settled.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Private/company restriction reaches ordinary public facilities and is under legal contestation, with no documented remedy.

care_services.exposure: Major institute stopped blockers/hormones to under-16s and 16-18s outside trials; 2022 guidance limits blockers to exceptional cases.
care_services.protection: Guidance is not a statutory ban; 2026 data show blocker prescriptions rose slightly since 2022.
care_services.interaction: Visitor emergency and adult care not documented; minor care access may be narrower if sought locally.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Far-right and Christian-democrat parties and women's umbrella platform frame reform as defence of women's rights/national values.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Gender identity added to hate-crime law 2018 and hate-speech law 2019.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Protections exist but hate-speech application is contested, e.g. declined imam prosecution and preacher acquittal on religious-speech grounds.

minors_guardians.exposure: From July 2025, 16-17 year olds need doctor/psychologist statement, health-authority approval and guardian consent for legal gender change.
minors_guardians.protection: Minimum age without dysphoria diagnosis lowered from 18 to 16; genital surgery 18+, gonad removal 23+.
minors_guardians.interaction: Resident LGR/medical rules are climate signals; visitor minor's concrete care or facility consequence is uncertain.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Scholars record political violence, threats and vilification against trans advocates, feminists and racialised activists.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Police-recorded LGBTQI hate-crime motive is the national dataset; no visitor attack pattern is documented.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Documented hostility is local/advocate-focused; no evidence it is directed at trans visitors or unremedied for them.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Pool restriction scope, other leisure facilities, and enactment of conversion-practices bill are unresolved.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Counselling centres in three cities offer legal assistance, mainly resident-focused.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Legal contestation of pool rule is reported but no outcome, compensation or correction is documented.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower: that anchor has a birth-sex bathroom rule in all publicly funded buildings upheld by courts. Here restriction is documented only for one swimming-pool chain, with contestation, and no general facility ban, so exposure is narrower.

Similar: lawful expression, accepted documents implied, some service friction and uneven remedies, no targeting. This case sits slightly above because hate-crime inclusion and no documented hotel refusals, but below clean correction shown there due to unremedied pool rule.

Higher: that anchor has no active facility restriction, an unenforced old offence, and enforced court compensation. Here an active changing-room restriction and contested hate-speech enforcement prevent that level.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: no traveller-facing criminal, border or custody exposure is documented, and hate-crime inclusion plus depathologisation signal institutional acceptance. The operative risk is narrower: a current pool-chain changing-room exclusion, unresolved legally, plus contested enforcement of speech protections and narrowed minor clinical guidance. Organised opposition frames trans inclusion as a threat to women, but no visitor targeting, sweeps or birth-sex placement is documented. Interaction is therefore limited facility/service friction rather than systemic coercion, placing it in reduced risk.
